, Tesco will integrate forecourt systems from Vontier operating companies Gilbarco Veeder-Root and Invenco.
The deployment combines Invenco’s outdoor payment terminals with Gilbarco Veeder-Root’s DOMS PSS 5000 Forecourt Controller to modernize Tesco's fueling network.
The integrated system bridges Tesco's point-of-sale software with pump operations to deliver real-time data, faster compliance, and a streamlined checkout experience across all sites.
The system's modular hardware and software architecture is designed to scale and adapt to future retail payment innovations across Tesco's fuel footprint.
